champion.notes: Keep scores and thresholds unchanged until full-session authoritative ledger evidence exists.

challengers.hypothesis: A dedicated low-float lane that does not require RVOL > 0.5 will capture structurally fragile stocks before relative-volume expansion makes them obvious.
changes: Add nano_low_float lane: small-cap, average volume >100K, price <$10, float <20M, with no RVOL minimum.
Reserve up to 250 of the 750 proactive-universe slots for the low-float lane before filling from the existing general lane.
Persist _discoveryLanes per ticker and measure Top-20 Early Capture <10% and <20% separately for general vs nano_low_float.
Sort signal-ledger paths monotonically by timestamp to prevent backward slope/velocity reads.

acceptanceCriteria.primary: Increase Top-20 Early Capture @ <20% without material false-ignition increase versus champion.
secondary: Reduce Universe Coverage Miss and Proactive Late rates.
Demonstrate incremental captures attributable specifically to nano_low_float.
Preserve data-field coverage and fail-closed integrity.

todayEvidence.interpretation: Today cannot validate Early-Capture performance because the authoritative ledger began after RTH close. It does validate the need to test universe expansion rather than retune scores.

versionPolicy: Do not bump TAGX version until the challenger produces a real schemaVersion 3 discovery snapshot and passes measured champion/challenger evaluation.
